question: Who was understanding, clever, haughty and reserved?
solution:
The correct answer is "**Darcy**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The person who is described as **understanding, clever, haughty, and reserved** is **Darcy**.
 
• As mentioned in the sentence: "**In understanding, Darcy was the superior. He was at the same time haughty, reserved, and fastidious, and his manners, though well-bred, were not inviting.**"

Thus, ***option 4*** is the correct answer.
